name: Tom Barrett
stance: Introduced legislation requiring human control of lethal autonomous weapons and a Cabinet-level AI official, and urges an international AI treaty.

statements.text: That’s why I introduced bipartisan legislation last week to put clear safeguards in place for autonomous tech in our military to make sure a human — not a computer — is in control of lethal force.
It’s clear we need an international agreement to put strong guardrails on this rapidly developing technology before it’s too late.
That’s why I’m fighting to put safeguards around this innovative technology and urging the Trump administration to negotiate an AI treaty that keeps our world safe.

These risks cannot be ignored, and my new bill will create a seat at the Cabinet table for an official to monitor AI technology, ensure strong guardrails, and prepare us for this new era of technological innovation and beyond.
